Delhi Government Approves Funds for School and Road Upgrades

The Delhi government has approved significant funding for infrastructure development, allocating Rs 264-265 crore for the upgrade of 75 CM SHRI schools. In a separate initiative, Rs 658 crore has been earmarked for the improvement of 270 km of roads across key corridors in the city. These projects aim to enhance educational facilities and urban infrastructure.
